en: A black‑and‑white, likely early-20th‑century postcard showing two side‑by‑side photographs of substantial masonry buildings along broad streets. The left image depicts an older complex with a high, simple gabled roof, a small round tower, and bare winter trees, set behind a low wall and an open square with a streetlamp. The right image shows a more ornate, three‑story neoclassical or historicist building with arched ground-floor openings and symmetrical windows. The card edges are ragged, and part of a German‑language printed text is visible cropped at the far left and right margins, suggesting it was mounted on or near a German text page.
